widgets_values:
## audio/albums/nill-bye/duty-switch/album

Album **Duty Switch** by **Nill Bye** (15 tracks).

Queue this graph to zip whatever is already in `${COMFY_OUTPUT_DIR}/albums/Nill Bye/Duty Switch/`.
Generate the full album in one go:

`./scripts/manage.sh album-render --album nill-bye/duty-switch --art skip|upload|generate`

Occupancy: audio for tracks, klein first when --art generate. Do not co-resident Klein + ACE-Step.
Prompt enhance is on by default (on-box Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507). After Queue, the Enhance node shows the prompt CLIP used (or a passthrough reason). Turn Enhance off to use the widget text as-is. Optional style dropdown.
